name: create_meeting_space
description:
Creates a new meeting space with specified configuration.

This function creates and stores a new GridwellMeet meeting space in the database
with a unique identifier and comprehensive configuration details including meeting
codes, access controls, and entry point settings. The space must have a unique name
that doesn't conflict with existing spaces. Once created, the space can be used to
host meetings and conferences with the specified access permissions and entry points.

space_name.description: The unique identifier (name) for the new meeting space. This must be a non-empty string that will serve as the key to identify and retrieve the space. The name must be unique across all existing spaces in the database and cannot consist solely of whitespace characters.

space_content.description: A structured object containing all the configuration details required for the new meeting space, including the meeting code, URI, access controls, and entry point settings. All required fields within this object must be provided to successfully create the space.

meetingCode.description: The unique alphanumeric code used to join this meeting space. This code is typically displayed as three groups separated by hyphens (e.g., 'abc-mnop-xyz') and can be used with the GridwellMeet 'Join with a code' feature. Must be globally unique across all meeting spaces.

meetingUri.description: The complete URI (Uniform Resource Identifier) that participants can use to directly join the meeting. This is typically a clickable link in the format 'https://meet.gridwell.com/{meetingCode}' that opens the meeting in a browser or the GridwellMeet app. Must be a valid, accessible URL.

accessType.description: The access control level for this meeting space, determining who can join the meeting. Valid values are: 'TRUSTED' (only authenticated users from the same organization can join), 'RESTRICTED' (only specific invited users can join), or 'OPEN' (anyone with the meeting code or URI can join without restriction).

entryPointAccess.description: Controls which entry points (such as phone dial-in, SIP addresses, or web links) are available for joining this meeting space. Valid values are: 'ALL' (all entry point types are available to all participants) or 'CREATOR_APP_ONLY' (entry points are restricted to the application that created the meeting space). Defaults to 'ALL' if not specified.

name: end_active_conference_in_space
description:
Ends an active conference in a meeting space.

This function terminates any currently active conference in the specified meeting space
by removing the activeConference field from the space record. This operation is
irreversible and permanently removes all active conference data (including conference ID
and details) from the space. The space itself remains intact and can be used for future
meetings. If no active conference exists in the space, the operation completes without
error and returns an informational message. This function is useful for cleanup operations
or when manually terminating a conference session.

name.description: The unique identifier (name) of the meeting space in which to end the active conference. Must be a non-empty string that corresponds to an existing space in the database.

name: get_conference_participant
description:
Gets a participant by ID.

Retrieves comprehensive information about a specific conference participant,
including their identifier, conference record, join time, and other
participant-specific properties. This function is useful for fetching details
about a particular participant after obtaining their resource name from a list
operation or other source.

name.description: Resource name of the participant. Must be a non-empty string that uniquely identifies the participant in the database.

name: get_conference_record
description:
Gets a conference record by conference ID.

Retrieves comprehensive detailed information about a specific conference record, including
its unique identifier, start and end timestamps, descriptive name, and meeting code.
This function is useful for obtaining complete details about a past or ongoing conference
session when you have its resource name or ID.

name.description: Resource name of the conference record to retrieve. Must be a non-empty string that uniquely identifies the conference record in the database. This is typically the conference ID (e.g., "conf1", "conf2").

name: get_conference_recording
description:
Gets a recording by recording ID.

Retrieves comprehensive information about a specific GridwellMeet recording,
including its identifier, parent conference record, start time, and other
recording-specific properties. This function is useful for fetching details
about a particular recording after obtaining its resource name from a list
operation or other source.

name.description: Resource name of the recording. Must be a non-empty string that uniquely identifies the recording in the database.

name: get_conference_transcript
description:
Gets a transcript by transcript ID.

Retrieves comprehensive information about a specific GridwellMeet transcript,
including its identifier, parent conference record, start time, and other
transcript-specific properties. This function is useful for fetching details
about a particular transcript after obtaining its resource name from a list
operation or other source.

name.description: Resource name of the transcript. Must be a non-empty string that uniquely identifies the transcript in the database.

name: get_meeting_space_details
description:
Gets details about a meeting space.

Retrieves comprehensive information about a specific GridwellMeet meeting space,
including its meeting code, URI, access controls, entry point settings, and
information about any active conference currently taking place in the space.
This function is useful for checking space configuration and availability before
joining or modifying a meeting.

name.description: The unique identifier (name) of the meeting space to retrieve. Must be a non-empty string that corresponds to a space in the database.

name: get_participant_session
description:
Gets a participant session by session ID.

Retrieves comprehensive detailed information about a specific participant session, including
the session identifier, parent participant ID, and join timestamp. A participant session
represents a single continuous period of participation in a conference - each time a
participant joins and leaves creates a new session. This function is useful for obtaining
details about a specific session instance when you have its resource name or ID.

name.description: Resource name (ID) of the participant session to retrieve. Must be a non-empty string that uniquely identifies the session in the database (e.g., "session1", "session2").

name: get_transcript_entry
description:
Gets a transcript entry by entry ID.

Retrieves detailed information about a specific transcript entry,
including its identifier, parent transcript, start time, and text content.
This function is useful for fetching details about a particular entry
after obtaining its resource name from a list operation or other source.

name.description: Resource name of the entry. Must be a non-empty string that uniquely identifies the entry in the database.

name: list_conference_participants
description:
Lists participants of a conference record.

Retrieves a paginated list of participants associated with a specific conference record.
This function supports pagination through the pageSize and pageToken parameters, allowing
retrieval of large result sets in manageable chunks.

parent.description: The parent conference record resource name. Must be a non-empty string.

pageSize.description: The maximum number of participants to return in a single page of results. Must be a positive integer (minimum 1). Defaults to 100 if not specified. Use smaller values for faster responses or larger values to reduce the number of API calls needed to retrieve all participants.

pageToken.description: The token for continued list pagination. Use the nextPageToken from a previous response to retrieve the next page of results. Defaults to None.

name: list_conference_recordings
description:
Lists the recordings of a conference.

Retrieves a paginated list of recordings associated with a specific conference record.
The recordings are sorted chronologically by start time in ascending order. This function
supports pagination through the pageSize and pageToken parameters, allowing retrieval
of large result sets in manageable chunks. If the parent parameter's last segment
doesn't match the parent_conference_record, an error response is returned.

parent.description: The parent resource name. Must be a non-empty string in the format 'conferenceRecords/{conferenceRecordId}'.

parent_conference_record.description: The parent conference record ID. Must be a non-empty string that matches the last segment of the parent resource name.

pageSize.description: The maximum number of recordings to return in a single page of results. Must be a positive integer (minimum 1). Defaults to 100 if not specified. Use smaller values for faster responses or larger values to reduce the number of API calls needed to retrieve all recordings.

pageToken.description: The token for continued list pagination. Use the nextPageToken from a previous response to retrieve the next page of results. Defaults to None.

name: list_conference_records
description:
Lists conference records with optional filtering and pagination.

Retrieves a paginated list of conference records from the database, optionally filtered
using a user specified filtering condition in EBNF format. Results are automatically
ordered by start time in descending chronological order (most recent conferences first),
making it easy to view the latest meeting activity. This function supports pagination to
efficiently handle large numbers of conference records, allowing clients to retrieve
results in manageable chunks.

filter.description: User specified filtering condition in EBNF format. The following are the filterable fields: space.meeting_code, space.name, start_time, end_time. For example: space.name = "spaces/NAME", space.meeting_code = "abc-mnop-xyz", start_time>="2024-01-01T00:00:00.000Z" AND start_time<="2024-01-02T00:00:00.000Z", end_time IS NULL. Multiple conditions can be combined using AND. If not provided, all records are returned. Defaults to None.

pageSize.description: The maximum number of conference records to return in a single page of results. Must be a positive integer (minimum 1). Defaults to 100 if not specified. Use smaller values for faster responses or larger values to reduce the number of API calls needed to retrieve all records.

pageToken.description: A pagination token obtained from a previous list_conference_records call. Use this to retrieve the next page of results. If not provided or set to None, the first page of results is returned. The token represents the starting index for the next set of results. Defaults to None.

name: list_conference_transcript
description:
Lists the transcripts of a conference.

Retrieves a paginated list of transcripts associated with a specific conference record.
The transcripts are sorted chronologically by start time in ascending order. This function
supports pagination through the pageSize and pageToken parameters, allowing retrieval
of large result sets in manageable chunks.

parent.description: The parent conference record resource name. Must be a non-empty string.

pageSize.description: The maximum number of transcripts to return in a single page of results. Must be a positive integer (minimum 1). Defaults to 100 if not specified. Use smaller values for faster responses or larger values to reduce the number of API calls needed to retrieve all transcripts.

pageToken.description: The token for continued list pagination. Use the nextPageToken from a previous response to retrieve the next page of results. Defaults to None.

name: list_participant_sessions
description:
Lists the sessions of a participant with optional filtering and pagination.

Retrieves all sessions associated with the specified participant from the database, optionally
filtered by a search string. A participant session represents a single continuous period of
participation in a conference - each time a participant joins and leaves creates a new session.
Results are automatically ordered by join time in ascending chronological order (earliest
sessions first), making it easy to track a participant's meeting history. This function supports
pagination to efficiently handle participants with many sessions across multiple meetings.

parent.description: The parent participant resource name (participant ID). Must be a non-empty string that identifies the participant whose sessions should be retrieved. This participant must exist in the database.

filter.description: An optional filter string to apply to the sessions. The filter is applied to the string representation of each session object in a case-insensitive manner, allowing you to search for sessions containing specific text patterns. If not provided, all sessions for the participant are returned.

pageSize.description: The maximum number of sessions to return in a single page of results. Must be a positive integer (minimum 1). Defaults to 100 if not specified. Use smaller values for faster responses or larger values to reduce the number of API calls needed to retrieve all sessions.

pageToken.description: A pagination token obtained from a previous list_participant_sessions call. Use this to retrieve the next page of results. If not provided or set to None, the first page of results is returned. The token represents the starting index for the next set of results.

name: list_transcript_entries
description:
Lists the entries of a transcript.

Retrieves a paginated list of entries associated with a specific transcript.
The entries are sorted chronologically by start time in ascending order. This function
supports pagination through the pageSize and pageToken parameters, allowing retrieval
of large result sets in manageable chunks.

parent.description: The parent transcript resource name. Must be a non-empty string.

pageSize.description: The maximum number of entries to return in a single page of results. Must be a positive integer (minimum 1). Defaults to 100 if not specified. Use smaller values for faster responses or larger values to reduce the number of API calls needed to retrieve all entries.

pageToken.description: The token for continued list pagination. Use the nextPageToken from a previous response to retrieve the next page of results. Defaults to None.

name: update_meeting_space
description:
Updates specific fields of an existing meeting space.

Performs a partial update (PATCH operation) on a meeting space, modifying only the
fields specified in the update_mask parameter while leaving all other fields unchanged.
Only fields with non-null values in the update_mask are applied; fields set to null
are skipped. This function is useful for making targeted configuration changes to a
space without needing to provide the complete space definition. Common use cases include
changing access controls, updating meeting codes/URIs, or managing active conference
information. To remove an active conference, use end_active_conference_in_space instead.

name.description: The unique identifier (name) of the meeting space to update. Must be a non-empty string that corresponds to an existing space in the database.

update_mask.description: A dictionary specifying which fields of the meeting space should be updated and their new values. Only fields with non-null values are applied; fields set to null are skipped and left unchanged. Fields not included in this dictionary remain unmodified. If None or an empty dictionary is provided, no changes will be made to the space. This enables precise, granular updates to space configuration.

meetingCode.description: The unique alphanumeric code used to join this meeting space. When updating, this code must remain globally unique across all meeting spaces. Format is typically three groups separated by hyphens (e.g., 'abc-mnop-xyz').

meetingUri.description: The complete URI (Uniform Resource Identifier) that participants can use to directly join the meeting. This is typically a clickable link in the format 'https://meet.gridwell.com/{meetingCode}' that opens the meeting in a browser or the GridwellMeet app.

accessType.description: The access control level for this meeting space, determining who can join the meeting. Valid values are: 'TRUSTED' (only authenticated users from the same organization can join), 'RESTRICTED' (only specific invited users can join), or 'OPEN' (anyone with the meeting code or URI can join without restriction).

entryPointAccess.description: Controls which entry points (such as phone dial-in, SIP addresses, or web links) are available for joining this meeting space. Valid values are: 'ALL' (all entry point types are available to all participants) or 'CREATOR_APP_ONLY' (entry points are restricted to the application that created the meeting space).

activeConference.description: Information about the currently active conference taking place in this space. When updating, you can set this to establish a new active conference or modify details of the existing one. To remove an active conference, use the dedicated end_active_conference_in_space function instead of this update operation.

conferenceId.description: The unique identifier for the currently active conference in this space. Must be a non-empty string.

details.description: Additional descriptive details about the currently active conference, such as the meeting title, purpose, or other contextual information.
